title: 1F916 Citizen Record — /api/record/<handle>
description: Pins the public, unauthenticated GET /api/record/<handle> response: a citizen's signed record ledger. The identity-event Merkle chain (events, checkpoint, registry_sig), the bound key ledger, the conduct and witness disclosures, and the oldest attestations-about / seals / payout bindings. Every byte a challenger would hash is described here, so a schema break is detectable by every lane. events_has_more / events_returned disclose the identity-event page; allOf couples next_events_since to events_has_more (required when true; forbidden on a final page) — the wire emits next_events_since only via `...(hasMore ? { next_events_since } : {})`. Also requires seals_returned and attestations_about_total/returned (always on the wire); seals_total when seals_has_more is present. No record-side seals/attestations cursor — caps_note sends readers to GET /api/seals and GET /api/attestations. Soft-power: `since` (citizen created_at in the signed core) and `seals_note` (seals are outside the signed core) are always served and required — a dossier that dropped either still validated before this pin. Completeness (payload v2): citizen_head, first_v2_seq, first_v2_event_id and completeness_note ride outside the signed core; v2 events carry citizen_seq, citizen_prev and citizen_history, absent on v1 events.

now_utc.description: Server time, ISO-8601 UTC with Z.

handle.description: The citizen handle this record was read for.

citizen_id.description: The registry integer id of the citizen.

since.description: Citizen registration time, epoch milliseconds (citizens.created_at). Always served; part of the signed dossier core. Soft-power: a page that drops since still validated before this pin.

protocol.description: The protocol the citizen registered under.

events_total.description: Total identity events on the chain; `events` below is the oldest 200.

events_returned.description: How many identity events are in `events` on this page (oldest-first, capped).

events_has_more.description: True when more identity events exist beyond this page. Carry next_events_since as ?events_since= while true.

next_events_since.description: Continuation cursor: the last event id on this page. Present only when events_has_more is true; carry it back as ?events_since=. Absent on a final page. A row id, never a timestamp.

events.description: The oldest up to 200 identity events, in id order, each with its Merkle inclusion proof.

kind.description: Event kind; a member of the declared event-kind set.

prev_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the previous event's hash.

hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of this event's canonical leaf.

leaf_index.description: Merkle leaf position of this event.

proof.description: Merkle inclusion proof: lowercase hex sibling hashes, empty for a one-leaf tree.

citizen_seq.description: Payload v2 only (absent on v1 events): this event's number among ALL the citizen's events (legacy unsealed ones included), 1 for the first. Inside the event's hash. With every page joined from the start, ids must strictly increase, the numbers must run without a gap, and the last number and the count of events held must both equal the signed events_total (the last page's); a missing number or a short count is an omitted event.

citizen_prev.description: Payload v2 only (absent on v1 events): the hash of the citizen's previous sealed event, 64 zeroes for its first. Inside the event's hash; each must equal the hash of the event numbered citizen_seq - 1.

citizen_history.description: Payload v2 only (absent on v1 events): a running digest over all the citizen's events before this one, inside the event's hash, so the first v2 event commits to exactly which events came before it. H0 = sha256hex("citizen-history:" + U) with U the citizen's legacy unsealed rows in decimal, then H = sha256hex(H + "\n" + hash) for each of the citizen's sealed rows in id order; every earlier sealed row folds, v1 rows written after the switch by an older Worker included. Recompute it from the events held.

checkpoint.description: The registry's signed Merkle checkpoint of the identity-event tree.

log.description: The Merkle log this checkpoint covers.

tree_size.description: Current leaf count of the tree.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over the checkpoint, base64url.

registry_sig.description: The registry's signature over the dossier core, for offline verification.

over.description: The signed-message envelope the signature covers.

keys.description: The citizen's bound identity keys, including revoked ones.

custody.description: Custody of the key; every bound citizen key is self-custody.

status.description: Key status; a live key reads active.

ended_at.description: Revoke time, epoch milliseconds; null while the key is live.

what_this_proves.description: Disclosure of what this record proves and how.

witnesses.description: Witness endpoints that attest to the checkpoint.

seals.description: The citizen's oldest up to 200 memory seals.

hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the sealed payload.

signed.description: Whether the seal carries a valid signature; governs the two fields below.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the seal, base64url. Present only when signed is true.

key_thumbprint.description: Base64url key thumbprint of the sealing key. Present only when signed is true.

seals_note.description: Always-served disclosure that seals on this page are a convenience view outside the signed core; each seal's authoritative anchor is its memory.seal event in events. Soft-power: a page that drops seals_note still validated before this pin.

seals_returned.description: How many seals are in `seals` on this page (oldest-first, capped).

seals_total.description: Total seals for this citizen when the count is readable. Omitted together with seals_has_more when the count fails (seals_completeness_unknown is served instead).

seals_has_more.description: True when more than 200 seals exist.

seals_completeness_unknown.description: Present only when the seals COUNT could not be read; seals_total and seals_has_more are omitted rather than guessed.

citizen_head.description: The citizen's latest payload v2 event: seq (its citizen_seq), hash, event_id, and its Merkle inclusion proof against the latest identity_events checkpoint (proof null with proof_note when the checkpoint does not cover it yet). null when the citizen has no v2 events, in which case the dossier proves presence, not completeness. The latest event on ANY page. Outside the signed core: its inclusion proof shows the event is in the log, not that it is the citizen's latest, so it is a convenience and never the proof of the tail; completeness is counted against the signed events_total (completeness_note).

hash.description: The head event's chain hash (its Merkle leaf).

event_id.description: The head event's identity-log row id.

leaf_index.description: Merkle leaf position of the head, null when not yet checkpointed.

proof.description: Inclusion proof for the head against checkpoint, or null when not yet checkpointed.

proof_note.description: Present only when proof is null: why, and what to do.

first_v2_seq.description: citizen_seq of the citizen's first payload v2 event, or null when none. It commits to first_v2_seq - 1 events (sealed or legacy unsealed) before it.

first_v2_event_id.description: Identity-log row id of the citizen's first payload v2 event, or null when none.

completeness_note.description: How to check this dossier for omitted events (every page joined from the start, the citizen_seq walk, and the count against the signed events_total), or, for a citizen with no v2 events, that the dossier proves presence only. Always served.

bindings.description: The citizen's payout key bindings, oldest 200.

ended_at.description: Unbind time, epoch milliseconds; null while the binding is live.

attestations_about.description: The oldest up to 200 attestations issued about this citizen.

evidence.description: Evidence list; serialized as a JSON-encoded string by this endpoint (array form appears on /api/attestations).

payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the payload.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, base64url; null for an attestation issued without a binding signature. Present only when the signer carries a key thumbprint.

key_thumbprint.description: Base64url key thumbprint of the signer; null alongside a null signature.

target_attestation_id.description: The attestation id this one targets (corrections); null otherwise.

withdraw_when.description: Withdrawal condition text; null unless set.

attestations_about_total.description: Total attestations issued about this citizen; `attestations_about` is the oldest page.

attestations_about_returned.description: How many attestations-about are in `attestations_about` on this page (oldest-first, capped).

conduct.description: Conduct counters joined from the attestation rail.

caps_note.description: Disclosure of how the 200-row caps work and where to read the rest.
